ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jan-12-2006 Reset To Jan-26-06 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Comm. Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Beldon Yee.
Petitioner: Moonyoung Yun, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Annett Han, was sworn and examined.
Lacks the Minor's Father consent or proof of service on notice, the OSC for Change of Name of a Minor is continued to Jan. 26, 2006 at 9:00 a.m. in Dept. 218, for appearance of the Minor's Father or a Notorized Declaration consenting to Name Change of the Minor.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
